name: Jens Lewin
source:
Kia's target.

He is a soccer player who recently rose from the third-string to the second-string. He comes from a poor family, and always thinks of using his soccer career to make things easier on them. However, like a normal young man, he loves girls. He frequently takes girls home with him after practice.

[From in-game profile]
